items: P2.3 (fifth retained unit: low-VGPR Q6 qmicro-planar owners)
title: Low-VGPR 16-column Q6 qmicro-planar prefill owners retained (rows 17-48)

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

change.summary: ROW_TILES_PER_BLOCK/OUT_TILES_PER_BLOCK template parameters preserve the plain <4,3> geometry and arithmetic while adding <2,1>/<3,1> 16-column owners. gfx1151 rows 17-32 use <2,1> on all six physical shapes; rows 33-48 use <3,1> on (5120,17408) and <2,1> on the other five; plain and >=512 shared4 behavior remains fail-closed.
change.basis: The prior real-model trace attributed 103.1 ms/pass to the 184-VGPR Q6 qmicro-planar family. Smaller accumulator owners restore residency while preserving each output tile's K16 WMMA/BF16 association.

selection_evidence.harness: /tmp/p210_ab.py (synthetic Q5T16/Q6T16 qmicro-planar; warmup 4 + 20 iterations; bit-exact cross-validation)

rows_45.all_six_shapes: selected lowvgpr/lowvgpr48 owner won by 23-50%; max_abs 0.0

selection_evidence.q5_followup: Q5 low-VGPR owners were bit-exact and faster on five of six rows-45 shapes, but dispatch remains separately gated because the gfx1151 registry must preserve qualified compact/verifier aliases.
